title: Phaseo · Web experience
description: Server-side errors and web API performance. Browser errors, sessions and Web Vitals live in the linked Frontend Observability app and require analytics consent.

targets.expr: sum(rate({service_name=~"phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", route="route" | __error__="" | route=~".*${route:regex}.*" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.request" | __error__="" [$__auto])) or vector(0)

matcher.options: ^(error|.* · error|Gateway actionable|Web API 5xx|Website server errors|Operational failures|Server errors|Delivery failures)$

targets.expr: sum(rate({service_name=~"phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", status_code="status_code", route="route" | __error__="" | route=~".*${route:regex}.*" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.request" | status_code >= 500 | __error__="" [$__auto])) or vector(0)

matcher.options: ^(error|.* · error|Gateway actionable|Web API 5xx|Website server errors|Operational failures|Server errors|Delivery failures)$

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name=~"phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", duration_ms="duration_ms", route="route" | __error__="" | route=~".*${route:regex}.*" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.request" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (service_name)

matcher.options: ^(error|.* · error|Gateway actionable|Web API 5xx|Website server errors|Operational failures|Server errors|Delivery failures)$

panels.title: Web server captured errors
panels.description: Captured server errors only. This hook does not provide a request denominator or server latency percentiles.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-web"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", route="route" | __error__="" | route=~".*${route:regex}.*" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.server_error" | __error__="" [$__auto])) or vector(0)

matcher.options: ^(error|.* · error|Gateway actionable|Web API 5xx|Website server errors|Operational failures|Server errors|Delivery failures)$

panels.title: Web API route health
panels.description: Selected-range received events. Up to 10 failing and 10 busiest groups; sorted by failures. Failure % uses the displayed requests population. p95 uses available timings; sparse samples are unstable. A dash means unavailable, not zero. Web API duration measures response headers; gateway duration measures terminal completion.

targets.expr: (sum by (method, route) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", method="method", route="route", status_code="status_code" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.request" | route=~".*${route:regex}.*" | __error__="" [$__range]))) and on (method, route) (topk(10, sum by (method, route) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", method="method", route="route", status_code="status_code" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.request" | route=~".*${route:regex}.*" | status_code >= 500 | __error__="" [$__range]))) or topk(10, sum by (method, route) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", method="method", route="route", status_code="status_code" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.request" | route=~".*${route:regex}.*" | __error__="" [$__range]))))

(((sum by (method, route) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", method="method", route="route", status_code="status_code" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.request" | route=~".*${route:regex}.*" | status_code >= 500 | __error__="" [$__range]))) or (0 * (sum by (method, route) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", method="method", route="route", status_code="status_code" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.request" | route=~".*${route:regex}.*" | __error__="" [$__range])))))) and on (method, route) (topk(10, sum by (method, route) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", method="method", route="route", status_code="status_code" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.request" | route=~".*${route:regex}.*" | status_code >= 500 | __error__="" [$__range]))) or topk(10, sum by (method, route) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", method="method", route="route", status_code="status_code" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.request" | route=~".*${route:regex}.*" | __error__="" [$__range]))))

(100 * ((sum by (method, route) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", method="method", route="route", status_code="status_code" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.request" | route=~".*${route:regex}.*" | status_code >= 500 | __error__="" [$__range]))) or (0 * (sum by (method, route) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", method="method", route="route", status_code="status_code" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.request" | route=~".*${route:regex}.*" | __error__="" [$__range]))))) / (sum by (method, route) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", method="method", route="route", status_code="status_code" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.request" | route=~".*${route:regex}.*" | __error__="" [$__range])))) and on (method, route) (topk(10, sum by (method, route) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", method="method", route="route", status_code="status_code" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.request" | route=~".*${route:regex}.*" | status_code >= 500 | __error__="" [$__range]))) or topk(10, sum by (method, route) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", method="method", route="route", status_code="status_code" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.request" | route=~".*${route:regex}.*" | __error__="" [$__range]))))

(quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name=~"phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", method="method", route="route", status_code="status_code", duration_ms="duration_ms" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.request" | route=~".*${route:regex}.*" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__range]) by (method, route)) and on (method, route) (topk(10, sum by (method, route) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", method="method", route="route", status_code="status_code" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.request" | route=~".*${route:regex}.*" | status_code >= 500 | __error__="" [$__range]))) or topk(10, sum by (method, route) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", method="method", route="route", status_code="status_code" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.request" | route=~".*${route:regex}.*" | __error__="" [$__range]))))

panels.title: Grouped failures
panels.description: Up to 20 most frequent failure groups in the selected range. Inspect category, code, digest and route, then expand matching logs for source frames. Event counts are not distinct incidents or affected users. Error messages and customer content are not collected.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (service_name, route, event_name, error_kind, error_code, error_name, error_digest, status_code, job) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-web-api|phaseo-web"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", route="route", error_kind="error_kind", error_code="error_code", error_name="error_name", error_digest="error_digest", status_code="status_code", job="job", actionable="actionable" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | route=~".*${route:regex}.*" | actionable="true" | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Website errors by release
panels.description: Captured website server errors by deployed release and fingerprint. No website request denominator exists, so these counts cannot establish a release error rate. Release comes from OTLP service.version metadata.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (service_version, error_name, error_digest) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-web"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", service_version="service_version", error_name="error_name", error_digest="error_digest", route="route" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.server_error" | route=~".*${route:regex}.*" | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Recent web API failures
panels.description: Newest 100 matching 5xx responses. Click trace ID for a retained trace. Header timing does not measure streamed response completion.

targets.expr: {service_name=~"phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", route="route", status_code="status_code" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.request" | route=~".*${route:regex}.*" | status_code >= 500

panels.title: Slow web API requests
panels.description: Newest 100 requests taking at least one second to response headers. These are recent slow samples, not the slowest requests across the entire range.

targets.expr: {service_name=~"phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", route="route", duration_ms="duration_ms" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.request" | route=~".*${route:regex}.*" | duration_ms >= 1000 | __error__=""

panels.title: Website error records
panels.description: Newest 100 captured website errors with redacted source frames. Filter the digest column to inspect a fingerprint. Error messages are omitted, and private source-map upload is not enabled.

targets.expr: {service_name=~"phaseo-web"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", route="route" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.server_error" | route=~".*${route:regex}.*"
